description: This Python source file defines classes and functions related to managing real-time contexts for OpenAI language models, including session management, message conversion, and aggregator classes for real-time processing and streaming. It includes deprecated warning notices and handles real-time conversation items, context upgrades, and frame processing.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: A subclass of OpenAILLMContext to support real-time session properties, message conversion, and session instructions. It facilitates upgrading standard contexts to real-time contexts and converting messages for real-time API use.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: A user context aggregator class intended for the openai realtime API, handling frame processing like message updates, with deprecated notification and special handling for real-time conversation flow.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An assistant context aggregator tailored for real-time API, filtering duplicate frames, handling function call results, and managing the flow of assistant output frames during real-time conversation processing.
